description: A grand residential front entry portico photographed at standing eye-level with a normal lens around 35-50mm, in a centered symmetrical composition looking directly at the front door from outside on the steps. Through the glass door, a lush green lawn and tree canopy are visible beyond. Two large white stone or concrete planters flank the door symmetrically, each holding an oversized broad-leaf tropical plant — bird-of-paradise or similar — with wide dark green glossy fronds. At the bottom corners, two rounded boxwood topiary balls add a formal note. The porch floor is large-format pale marble or travertine tile with veined grey and cream tones. The porch ceiling is dark stained horizontal tongue-and-groove wood planking in a rich espresso or dark walnut tone, providing a warm dark contrast to the pale facade. A warm amber glow from an unseen overhead source in the porch ceiling catches on the ceiling boards and door surround. The mood is classically elegant, Southern or New Orleans plantation inspired.
